div.div: طَرَّارٌ A cutpurse; one who cuts, or slits, purses, (A, Mgh, Msb, * TA,) and takes people's money at unawares: (Msb:) or who slits a man's sleeve, [in which he carries his money and the like,] and gently extracts what is in it: (TA:) from الطَّرُّ “ the act of slitting ” (S, Msb) and “ cutting. ” (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
